purpose: Activate only the canonical API artifact and Public API and SDK-owned positron-api behavior required by M0-03.

attempts.result: 100 percent line, region, branch, and function coverage for the canonical generated API owner

19 mutants: 4 caught, 2 missed, and 13 tool-unviable. One missed mutant exposed the missing explicit v1-major assertion; the second was a semantic-equivalent replacement of the literal return. The assertion was added and the equivalent match target was removed. This failed attempt remains retained; mutation must run once in trusted CI on the final exact commit.

cargo vet check rejected the first sha2 0.11.0 candidate and its nine unvetted dependencies. The failed attempt was retained; the dependency was narrowed to imported-audit-covered sha2 0.10.9 with exact transitive exemptions.
The expanded public contract test failed to compile with 24 missing capability, transport, safe-detail, bounded decode, and client contract items against the pre-remediation generated surface.

Nine deterministic public tests passed. Representative old-client and current-client gRPC and HTTP requests produced byte-stable equal typed outcomes; version, unavailable, unsupported, malformed, oversized, duplicate, unknown-field, and redaction cases returned their closed outcomes.

Five bounded generator tests passed. RPC, request field name, and request field number mutations propagated to generated Rust, HTTP, and OpenAPI; ambiguous declarations, duplicate field numbers, and oversized sources failed closed; repeated generation was byte-identical.
Cargo Vet accepted three fully audited and seven exact-version-exempted crates; Cargo Deny accepted advisories, exact-version bans, licenses, and sources.

detection_gained: one bounded parsed versioned Protobuf source generates the Rust, gRPC and HTTP decode mapping, client contract, OpenAPI, and Schema Digest foundations
the public contract proves implemented, unavailable, unsupported, and version-incompatible capability outcomes with safe typed errors and no wire or domain leakage
the canonical artifact scope cannot return to scaffold, accept unknown fields, exceed its 64-byte request bound, or drift from deterministic generation
the authoritative EXT runner owns M0-03 coverage and the explicit exact-selector mutation campaign without changing routine PR selection
migration: No durable format, SDK publication, listener, provider, query, signal-store, clustering, or Release 1 qualification claim is introduced. The implemented candidate remains unqualified until exact-artifact M6 evidence.
